[spoiler=[i]"Not through speeches and majority decisions are the great questions of the day decidedthat was the great mistake of 1848 and 1849but through blood and iron."[/i]

- [b]Chancellor Otto von Bismarck[/b] -]

Address From the Chancellery  Office of the Chancellor 

Chancellor Sebastian Vogt  14:50 ET

My fellow citizens, 

The Hochdeutsche Defense Forces, under my orders, have carried out strikes against the authoritarian regime in Rosenmarkke. Our armed forces have begun the process of fully eliminating the threat posed to the Republik and its allies. We have struck decisively and successfully at the regimes ability to wage war, oppress its people, overthrow democratic governments and threaten the world with weapons of mass destruction. 

There is no doubt in my mind that the regime, the intelligence services controlling it and its dictator pose an immediate threat to Elseyran security. To achieve the imperatives assigned to me by the Hochdeutsche people, the HDF will continue to utilize every measure possible to seek out and destroy threats to national security. This is the one overarching imperative of my administration. In this war there will be no campaign of half measures. The only outcome we will accept is victory. 

May god bless our country and all those who defend her. 

The B-1B Lancers, firing from over 600 kilometers away would largely be out of the effective engagement window of SAMs. Republik aircraft are largely protected due to their ALE-70 towed decoys. Using three layers of protection including jamming which relays false information to targeting radars through a fiber optic link to the aircrafts AN/ASQ-39 EWS, deflection by sending tailored signals to confuse SAMs as well as finally emitting signals to pull missiles towards it instead of the aircraft as a final layer of defense. Also, because of Republik fifth generation fighters having significant stealth capabilities such as radar absorbent material, angular shapes and an internal weapons bay the fighter fleet is unharmed. 

During the duration of the past week the Republik would continue its assault with a focus on the islands located within the White Strait. Every night HDF forces would send continuous swarms of KV drones in the hundreds to exhaust air defenses with the purpose of striking critical targets including military bases, radar systems and arms depots. Additionally, lower cost cruise missiles such as the Barracuda would join the drone swarms in striking targets after being deployed from their rapid dragon cells. As strikes continued throughout the week the JA-35 SEAD presence would also be continuous, preparing to strike radars should they activate to try to intercept the incoming waves targeting Rosenmarkett military infrastructure. 

At two in the morning on Sunday, the strikes would come again but this time aided by further munitions. Moving from northern Wuloosya six hundred KV one-way attack drones would move across the strait towards the islands. FAMM cruise missiles dropped from the back of cargo aircraft deep within Wuloosya would join the strike as well. Using terrain-contour mapping and 5g maneuverability the cruise missiles stick low to the ground to try to avoid radar detection to minimize risk of interception while traveling towards their targets. From the Republik surface fleet Tomahawk missiles are fired off, using low altitude to lower chances of detection and interception. These munitions are used to strike Rosenmarkke fuel supplies, missile launch sites, portions of the power grid used in any capacity to support military operations and bases. Additionally, 164 cruise missiles fired from the Donau-Klasse SSGN are targeted against Rosenmarkke naval bases and dry docks to try to cut off supply and repair for the Rosenmarkket navy. 

Using Klinge 200 drones, the Republik aims to establish a continual assault against the newly positioned howitzers on the shorelines of the islands. Although they are camouflaged the hundreds of howitzers positioned on the shorelines would be a clear target for not only the electro-optical cameras of the drones but the saturated aperture radar of the Republik. The autonomous drones, not relying on a connection to an operator, continuously use their cameras and machine learning automatic target recognition to strike howitzers in all weather conditions. Due to the relatively cheap nature of the drones they are sent in the hundreds to saturate the environment within the islands to ensure constant assault and vulnerability for the howitzers. From HDF JA-35s, JASSM-ERs are used to strike targets across the islands. With their radar absorbent capabilities, internal engine intake and 1,000 lb blast-fragmentation warhead the missiles target major arms depots, bases, maintenance centers and fuel storage for forces on the island to stall the Rosenmarkket defense. Additionally, the missiles are used to strike transportation systems used by the military including roads, tunnels and bridges to stall any response to HDF and WDF attacks. Against fortifications on the islands such as bunkers, thermobarics are used by the HDF. The bombs which flood enclosed spaces with fine fuel aerosols and then ignites them helps to not only create a high temperature blast to collapse structures but also consume the oxygen to cut off enclosed structures and their defenders from air. 

As massive Rosenmarkket movements to fortify the islands continued so would the Republik response to cut off supplies. LRASM missiles fired off from stand off ranges from B-1B Lancer strategic bombers would be used to strike military supply ships moving troops, cargo, and vehicles to the islands. The sheer mass of armored vehicles moving to the islands would become a glaring target for the anti-ship strikes. The angular shaping and radar absorbing materials coated onto the LRASMs aid their mission of interception while its sea skimming further reduces radar detection. B-25EX stealth bombers at night keep up strikes against the Rosenmarkke naval force. Using 500-lb variants of the QUICKSINK JDAM the bombers are able to engage 80 targets at a time with the purpose of detonating at or near hulls to destroy the Rosenmarkket surface fleet. Land-based HDF platforms in Wuloosya join the fight against Rosenmarkket naval forces as well as working to cut off any resupply of Rosenmarkke forces in the islands. PrSM anti-ship ballistic platforms traveling mach 4 in their terminal phase as well as naval strike missiles utilizing sea skimming along with passive radar/infrared sensors for targeting. Additionally, unnamed surface vehicles would be used to autonomously target Rosenmarkke resupply ships and naval ships in swarms. Using both warheads as well as loitering munitions the USVs aim to use the littoral waters to blend into the environment while attempting to overwhelm defenses. Further DF-26Bs are fired towards the remaining Rosenmarkket carriers. Using a top speed of mach 10 at reentry and a maneuverable reentry vehicle the ballistic missiles combine high speed and maneuvering to try to deliver 4,000 lb warheads. 

To track and kill Rosenmarkket subs the geography of the strait plays into the advantage of the HDF. Due to the relatively limited space within the White Strait compared to the open ocean and straits being generally shallower than the open ocean the HDF presses its ASW advantages. Because of the limited space to maneuver in the strait large amounts of sonobuoys are dropped across the strait along with towed sonar arrays to both passively try to detect as well as actively track. Additionally, dipping sonars from Seahawks are used to actively ping the strait to search for the submarines. Should they be found a wide measure of tactics would be utilized to neutralize the threat. SMART systems using a two stage system allow for a rapid torpedo response. Using a missile propellant which then drops off a torpedo near the target the HDF is able to quickly respond to Rosenmarkke submarines. Additionally, UUVs are used en masse to swarm Rosenmarkke submarines using their Mk48 CRAW torpedoes to strike the subs. 

During the duration of the strikes and throughout the conflict a SEAD presence would be maintained by the EA-18Gs and JA-35s. The AARGM-ERs, allowing the JA-35s to fire at standoff positions are used to constantly target Rosenmarkke radars that light up. To counter decoys a host of detection methods are used to ensure the targeting of real targets. Satellite surveillance, electro-optical cameras from stealth drones, radar warning receivers and signal triangulation are all used to help verify the authenticity of SAMs. To fight the blinking systems of the SAMs the AARGMs use their INS and GPS are able to continue to proceed to the area of the last-known emission. Even should the SAM system move, the AARGM-ERs are designed to use radars in their terminal stages to help track and target SAMs independently. 

In the air, the HDF would push to challenge the Rosenmarkket jets for air superiority. With J-15s and JA-35s commanding Vectis CCAs from behind, the Vectis CCAs fire off Meteor BVRAAMs which utilize a top range of 300 kilometers, supersonic mach 4 speeds and a no escape zone of 60 kilometers to maximize effectiveness. Its fire and forget capabilities mean that the missiles dont require a connection with the launcher or jets allowing it to be nearly impervious to jamming. For air targets further within Rosenmarkke including refuelers and AWACS, AIM-174Bs from JA-18s can push 400 kilometers into Rosenmarkke airspace to track down targets. When groups of Rosenmarkket jets would land for maintenance, rest or refueling, ALBMs would allow a quick response by letting the Republik to attempt to strike the jets on the ground within minutes. 

Additionally, the HDF would also work to search for Rosenmarkket bunkers. Using space-based LiDAR radar to search for subtle elevation changes and thermal imaging to search for exhaust from exhaust vents and power generators as well as electro-optical monitoring of movements through AU-11J stealth drones the HDF would cast a wide net to look for the bunkers of Rosenmarkket military and security leadership. Additionally, RC-135s would contribute as well by monitoring large amounts of communications and providing continuous SIGINT to Republik intelligence efforts. Once bunkers were identified, B-21 Raiders at night would carry out strikes using GBU-57 bunker buster penetrators.[/spoiler]
